definitions.explanation: A good-looking man, especially one who plays romantic leading roles. Originated from kabuki theater terminology.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二枚目|にまいめ}{俳優|はいゆう}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: He is famous as a handsome leading actor.

examples.japanese: {二枚目|にまいめ}{半|はん}のキャラクターが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: The character who is both handsome and funny is popular.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}は{二枚目|にまいめ}なのに、{性格|せいかく}は{三枚目|さんまいめ}だ。
examples.english: He has a handsome face, but his personality is more like a comedian.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From kabuki theater, where the roles were listed on signboards ({看板|かんばん}). The second board ({二枚目|にまいめ}, literally "second sheet") listed the romantic lead roles played by handsome actors.

KABUKI ROLE SYSTEM:
・{一枚目|いちまいめ} - main male lead (serious hero)
・{二枚目|にまいめ} - romantic lead (handsome heartthrob)
・{三枚目|さんまいめ} - comedic role

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{二枚目|にまいめ}{俳優|はいゆう} - handsome actor
・{二枚目|にまいめ}{半|はん} - someone who is both handsome and funny (lit. "two-and-a-half board")

MODERN USAGE:
Today, {二枚目|にまいめ} is used casually to describe any good-looking man, not just actors.

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. Slightly playful or old-fashioned feel.
